summary: Modularize and harden agent conformance checks

delivery.outcome: Modularize standard/conformance.py below 500 lines, fix the late-binding lambda closure bug in run_all() that shadowed 14 adversarial test cases, and enforce strict JSON Schema parity, duplicate-key rejection, bool-as-int rejection, and symlink rejection.
nonGoals: Do not modify pinned standard/agent.schema.json or standard/agent.v1.gbnf digests.

architecture.decision: Extract shared primitives, schema loader, and fixture factories into standard/agent_contracts.py, harden validators in standard/conformance.py and standard/repository_publisher_conformance.py, and add unit coverage in standard/test_conformance.py.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-012 commit on main.

validation.evidence: All agent and publisher conformance suites, unit tests, modularity checks, and governance checks pass.
